description: Proof-of-delivery sufficiency against a required evidence list — Checks whether the proof-of-delivery evidence supplied (signature, photo, timestamp, GPS fix, recipient name, scan ...) satisfies the carrier or contract requirement list the caller gives: every required item, plus optional 'at least k of these' groups, with value bounds (for example GPS accuracy at most 30 m) and maximum age. For an agent assembling a delivery dispute or a payment release. Return

anyOf.description: Alternative groups: at least atLeast (default 1) of the keys must be present.

asOf.description: Reference instant (ISO date or instant) for evidence age; required only when a need sets maxAgeDays. The check never reads the clock.
When this was observed (ISO date or instant).

value.description: Observed JSON value. Omitted means the fact is present with no value; false or null means observed absent.

required.description: Evidence every proof must contain (key plus optional bounds).

equals.description: The evidence value must equal this JSON value (deep equality).

max.description: Inclusive upper bound, same comparison rules as min.

maxAgeDays.description: Evidence must be dated (asOf on the evidence item) and at most this many days before the request asOf.

min.description: Inclusive lower bound. Numbers compare numerically; two dotted-digit strings (1.10.2) compare segment by segment.

oneOf.description: The evidence value must equal one of these.

name: pod-sufficiency
